title.narrative: Kenya – E-mobility for two- and three-wheelers

description.narrative: Transport sector emissions in Kenya are expected to exceed 20m tCO2e by 2030. With ongoing rapid motorisation, the country has a significant leapfrog opportunity for e-mobility. To help transform the market, the project focus on facilitating the penetration of electric two-(e-2Ws) and three-wheelers (e-3Ws) in peri-urban and rural areas . Through the financial mechanism, the project targets both supply and demand sides providing credit guarantees to manufacturers of e-2Ws and e-3Ws and for owners of commercial fleets as well as purchase subsidies for individual owners. Technical support focuses on the enhancement of policy/regulator/fiscal frameworks at the national and sub-national levels. With these measures, the project aimed to reach a 15% market penetration and 80% local assembly of e-2Ws and e-3Ws by 2028 and create 3,500 green jobs in the EV-sector. The GHG emissions mitigation potential of the project is ca. 1m tCO2e.
